new_src='''def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(cell for row in grid for cell in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    foreground = max((color for color in counts if color != background), key=counts.get)
    points = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == foreground]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in points), max(r for r, c in points)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in points), max(c for r, c in points)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    def fill(r, c):
        if out[r][c] == background:
            out[r][c] = 2
    for c in range(c0, c1 + 1):
        fill(r0, c)
        fill(r1, c)
    for r in range(r0, r1 + 1):
        fill(r, c0)
        fill(r, c1)
    for r in range(h):
        marks = [c for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == foreground]
        if len(marks) >= 4:
            for c in range(min(marks), max(marks) + 1):
                fill(r, c)
    for c in range(w):
        marks = [r for r in range(h) if grid[r][c] == foreground]
        if len(marks) >= 4:
            for r in range(min(marks), max(marks) + 1):
                fill(r, c)
    return out
'''
